notes.title: 🐰Sanfu x Tiny Pasture Collaboration Begins!
notes.notes:
Dear Ranchers,

We are thrilled to announce a special collaboration between Tiny Pasture and the renowned Chinese suspense puzzle game, "Sanfu"!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172897/f1772a479031b6e5ad3afac7208b29037baeefc0.png[/img]

To celebrate the 2nd anniversary of "Sanfu"'s release, the mysterious "Sanyan Magical Bunny" will now appear in our Tiny Pasture, accompanying you while you work and study and becoming your new desktop companion!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45172897/4f22cd0f531a7c9ddc0cba0add71d8d373136bb6.gif[/img]

(Unlock method: Raise 10 rabbits to adulthood in the game to unlock the Sanyan Magical Bunny)

At the same time, we are launching a special crossover bundle! A limited-time discount is now available! It's a fantastic deal to buy both games right now! Come and bring your new desktop companion home!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/56377/Sanfu__Tiny_Pasture/

[h3]About "Sanfu"[/h3]

"Sanfu" is a Chinese-themed suspense-mystery puzzle game. In the year 2000, a strange old advertisement inexplicably appears on the screen of the Shancheng City news channel. The spokesperson in the ad is the "Sanyan Prodigy," a young psychic who has already passed away. Rumors circulate that the restless spirit of the Sanyan Prodigy has hijacked the television signal. The Investigation Bureau is ordered to look into the matter. As the investigation deepens, a criminal organization hidden in the shadows gradually comes to light.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1880330/_/

[hr][/hr]
Other Updates:

- New sound effect settings have been added, allowing you to adjust the volume of animal sound effects.
- A new setting has been added to turn the sound effects of the Magic Broom on or off while it is working.

[hr][/hr]

And there are more new friends from collaboration games! Don't forget to unlock them for free in Tiny Pasture!

notes.title: 🐟 Over 30 New Fish! Azure Waters DLC Launches Today!
notes.notes:
Dear Ranchers,

We're thrilled to share some exciting news! Our first-ever themed DLC, 🐟 Tiny Pasture: Azure Waters, is officially live! Over 30 brand-new fish species are waiting for you to unlock! What's more, we've also released a FREE DLC: "Ribbitribbit and Quackquack"! To celebrate this major game update, the base game is also on a 20% limited-time discount. If you haven't picked up the game yet, now's the perfect time to dive in!

[h2]🐟[Tiny Pasture: Azure Waters] — Our First Themed DLC[/h2]

As summer heats up, your Tiny Pasture transforms into a refreshing Desktop Aquarium, inviting you to dive into a cool aquatic world! Adorable fish will accompany you through every moment of work and study. Not only can you unlock more fish species and enrich your aquarium's ecosystem, but you can also create your very own mini underwater paradise.

Watch your fish swim freely, interact with them, collect the coins they drop, accumulate resources, and gradually expand your aquarium. Let your entire desktop come alive with dynamic, soothing charm!

[h3]The DLC includes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Over 30 different fish species
[*] Water effect backgrounds
[*] Dynamic decorations
[/list]
[h2]🔥Limited-time discount is now active. Add to cart today![/h2]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3734130/_DLC/

[h2]🎁Amazing "Deluxe Edition" Offer Now Available![/h2]

Purchase once to instantly unlock the Base Game + Azure Waters + Supporter Pack! Grab it now to enjoy a limited-time bundle discount – it's an incredible deal!

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/55051/_/

[h3]🐸Claim Your FREE DLC Now — [Ribbitribbit and Quackquack]![/h3]

To thank you all for your continuous support and love for Tiny Pasture, we've specially released this free DLC, featuring two brand-new little critters: a frog and a duck! Summer's here, so bring these lively waterside companions back to your ranch!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3687640/_/

[h3]🐑 Don't forget to claim the previous FREE DLC — Baabaa and Moomoo![/h3]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3592330/_/

If you're still missing a cute desktop companion, don't hesitate! Bring Tiny Pasture home today!

[hr][/hr]

[h3]Update[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new pasture slots (increased from 21 to 36).
[*] Added a DLC management interface. It can be accessed via the Start Menu or from the last animal slot in the in-game shop. In this interface, you can view, enable, or disable individual DLCs.
[*] Increased the maximum upgrade level for the feeding, cleaning, and coin collection facilities (from level 5 to level 9).
[*] Optimized decoration delete and move modes: After deleting or moving a decoration, you will now stay in the same mode, allowing for continuous actions.
[*] Removed cooldown for healing items. Healing items can now be used repeatedly on animals without delay.
[*] Slightly reduced the frequency of animal speech bubbles.
[/list]
Important Notice: The Azure Waters DLC uses animal IDs 101–132, which may conflict with certain mods.
If you encounter mod conflicts, please unsubscribe from the conflicting mods and restart the game.

notes.title: Ver1.1.2 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h2]New Additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added a new sheep color and a new cow color.  
[*] Improved compatibility with mod animals. If your pasture contains animals from unsubscribed mods, they will now automatically be removed upon launching the game to prevent crashes.  
[*] Introduced a new "Starry Night" background in the shop (perfect for players facing black screen issues—it can cover up your dark skies).  
[*] Added a confirmation pop-up when selling higher rarity animals to avoid accidental actions.  
[/list]
[h2]Optimizations[/h2]
[list]
[*] Placement restrictions for non-harvestable decorations have been greatly reduced. You can now stack them as you wish!  
[*] Moved the animal breeding interface from the shop to the management panel, allowing simultaneous breeding and card drawing.  
[*] Fixed a bug where switching between multiple screens with different resolutions could cause pasture display errors (your broom and the little house on the right should no longer disappear).  
[/list]

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]

[h2]New Feature: Pasture Switching[/h2]

You can now switch Pastures through the management interface by clicking the "Switch to this Pasture" button. Once switched, the management display order will automatically update(keeping the active Pasture at the top).

Switching pastures also changes the background, decorations, and facility positions. If any facilities end up outside the screen after switching, you’ll need to manually adjust their positions in the store.

notes.title: Tiny Pasture Developer Q&A
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! Thank you so much for loving and supporting "Tiny Pasture"! We've received a lot of questions recently, so we thought we'd answer some of the most common ones here.

[h3]Q: Will there be new animals added in the future?[/h3]
A: Absolutely! We welcome everyone to join our game's [url=https://discord.gg/znRNTBYR3H]Discord[/url]. Head over to the "new animal suggestion" and "idea" channels, and let us know which animals and other content you’d love to see added！

[h3]Q: Will there be support for the Workshop in the future?[/h3]
A: We're planning on it! But first, we're focusing on optimizing the game and adding new features (like sorting animals by rate, switching Pastures, etc.) Once we're done with that, we'll start working on the Workshop.

[h3]Q: What should I do if the game shows a black background?[/h3]
A: Check out the [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/3167550/view/523084408406672200?l=english]Ver1.0.9 patch notes [/url]for fixes related to the black background issue!

[h3]Q: Can I get the desktop wallpaper from the Steam store screenshots?[/h3]
A: That wallpaper is actually from our previous game, Garlic Builder. Thanks for loving it! I've posted it in our discord. Feel free to download it (but please, no commercial use).

[h3]🐰One last heartfelt message:[/h3]
Thank you so much for loving our game! We never imagined it would be this popular before its release. We've received many heartwarming messages and encouragements recently, and we're deeply touched. We've also noted your suggestions, and we'll keep working hard to enrich the game content and add more animals! Wishing you all a wonderful life!

notes.title: Ver1.0.9 patch notes【fixes related to the black background issue】

We've been hard at work these past few days tackling the black background issue, and it looks like we've found a solution. If you're still experiencing the black screen problem, try uninstalling and reinstalling the game—it should fix the issue!

If reinstalling doesn't solve the problem, please check out some solutions we've gathered in the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3167550/discussions/0/632295902087749042/]discussions table[/url]. A few players have also shared other fixes, and we've compiled them for you. Big thanks to everyone!

If none of these solutions work for you, don't worry. We're currently developing a dynamic sky feature that will cover the black screen at the bottom. This dynamic sky will be added to the Store - Decorations and can overlay any in-game background. Check out the GIF below!

5.Optimized the display logic for breeding. Now, offspring will immediately appear in the management interface after breeding.

notes.title: 📢One Week Countdown to Launch! Get Ready to Meet Your Adorable Animals on Feb18
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!

Our game Tiny Pasture, which we've been pouring our hearts into for the past year, is finally launching on February 18th—just one week away!

With the release date drawing closer, we're working hard on the final optimizations. However, due to the numerous new features in the full version, demo save data won't carry over. We are so sorry for this inconvenience!

In the full game, we've added several features to enhance your ranching experience:

1. When drawing animals, you can now select the target quality and perform ten draws or automatic continuous draws (you can keep it running in the background).
2. You can name your animals now!
3. You can sort animals in the management interface by quality or acquisition time.
4. Mark and pin your favorite animals in the management interface! This feature also prevents you from accidentally selling them.
5. Encyclopedia feature unlocked! Do you wanna see the full rainbow animals in your encyclopedia?
6. A button to keep animals in their juvenile form (without affecting adult benefits)!
7. Breeding feature unlocked! Let your bunnies reap the same benefits as your alpacas!
8. Money-collecting bees unlocked! They'll help you collect earnings from your fully paid animals.
9. Added a secondary confirmation pop-up for the new game button.

We hope these optimizations will provide a better gaming experience for everyone!

[*] A note explaining long-pressing to drop carrots has been added.
[*]  A note explaining right-click to drag the ranch has been added.
[/list]
[/olist]
